branding.boot_logo_description: Circuit board leaf inside a glowing teal ring — transparent background, 972x972px PNG
branding.boot_splash: Plymouth splash screen using boot_logo.png centered on dark background

os.kernel_notes: Custom config targeting Haswell microarchitecture, eMMC storage, i915 GPU, iwlwifi for Intel 7260
kernel_optimizations: Disable unused drivers (SCSI tape, floppy, parallel port, etc.)

gui.note: Decision deferred until base footprint is measured against 16GB eMMC budget

terminal.multiplexer_notes: Split panes, multiple windows, session persistence — no GUI required. Replaces Terminator for CLI-first workflow.
terminal.shell_notes: zsh is Kali's default since 2020 — matches existing workflow on the device.

emoji_support.font_notes: Nerd Font required for full emoji + icon rendering in terminal scripts and prompt
emoji_support.notes: Emoji usable directly in zsh scripts, prompt, and tmux status bar

clients: Tailscale — mesh VPN, zero-config peer-to-peer, CLI via tailscale up/down/status
OpenVPN — traditional VPN, wide server compatibility
nmcli — NetworkManager CLI for any configured VPN
vpn_support.tailscale_notes: Preferred VPN for remote access. Runs as a daemon (tailscaled), WireGuard-based under the hood. Install via official apt repo.

storage_budget.notes: Tight budget — no large desktop environments, careful package selection required

goals: tmux as multi-terminal interface — no GUI dependency
i915 driver retained for optional GUI path
Debian minimal as clean, proven base
